author: forthommel
body:
Figured out that, on a CMSSW_20_1_X IB, having to run a `ProjectRename` (after I somehow messed up something with a `git stash`) leads to a possibly outdated usage suggestion.

- Using `scramv1 b ProjectRename`:
  ```sh
  usage: projectAreaRename.py [-h] olddir newtop arch [dir]
  projectAreaRename.py: error: the following arguments are required: arch
  Done: ProjectRename
  ```

- Using `scramb1 b -r ProjectRename`:
  ```sh
  Done: ProjectRename
  ```
title: Update error message for project rename command
